'''Krugh Agovast''' was an individual who served within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Holding the rank of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] in the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]], Agovast served as the cargo master and [[Crew chief/Legends|crew chief]] at the [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]] [[Gelgelar Free Port/Legends|Free Port]] under the command of [[Arik Stijhl]].
